mapping: Native argmax predictions mapped to family. DoS variants/attempts -> DoS; Web Attack - Brute Force/attempts -> BruteForce; Portscan -> PortScan; remaining unsupported attacks -> OTHER_ATTACK. No renormalizing away unsupported predictions.
scope: Same 20 saved mixed-traffic captures; no new traffic or fitting. Refined-flow uses 21 features on ten-packet prefixes; CICIDS uses pinned corrected 80-feature completed flows. Different observation budgets and emitted record counts prevent strict prefix-to-completed equivalence.
